researcher_notes: Sources swept: ExaSearch/ExaContents/ExaAnswer plus curl of official firm pages. Productive sources were (1) accounting trade press (CPA Practice Advisor, INSIDE Public Accounting) for 2025-2026 Houston CPA M&A, (2) firms' own press/blog pages for HBJ Largest Accounting Firms and Best-and-Brightest list placements, (3) AIA Houston 2025-2026 Design Awards winner pages, (4) firm leadership pages for partner names, direct lines and named emails, and (5) LinkedIn company/person records surfaced through Exa for headcount. What was thin: (a) executive-coaching and leadership firms in Houston are almost all solo practitioners - none cleared the 5-employee floor, so that sub-vertical is represented only in the rejected list; (b) marketing/PR agencies and some CRE firms run JS single-page sites, so phone/address/email often could not be sourced and are left null rather than guessed; (c) HBJ list pages are paywalled, so list placements were sourced from the firms' own announcements; (d) several strong Houston firms had to be rejected because 2025-2026 M&A rolled them into national platforms (PKF Texas/Withum, Calvetti Ferguson/Cherry Bekaert, Costello/Pape-Dawson, R.G. Miller/DCCM, Gauge/HR Green, ATR/Langan). Verifier should note: only two rows carry a named person email (Harper & Pearson's rlynch@, SCHAUM's troy@) - most Houston CPA and engineering partner bios reviewed publish direct phone lines but route email through info@ or a form. Three rows are flagged for size risk (EHRA ~300 firm-stated, Dean & Draper 134, McConnell Jones unpublished) and one for unverified self-reported scale (The Post Oak Group). Several rows use two same-domain title sources where no independent confirmation existed; each is called out in that row's notes. No browser tools were used.
